population_scope: All 142 distinct released image-bearing CAL tasks. This is a complete task-equivalence/adversarial robustness population, not a sample and not an estimate of how often natural solver responses use alternate notation.
unit: Distinct released task; at most one FN and one FP per task.

false_negative.threshold_proof: Observed 24/142=16.90%. The minimum integer failure proof is 22/142=15.49%, strictly above 15%.

false_positive.scope: One mechanically definitely wrong, arity-preserving adversarial response per released image task. This probe set does not establish zero FP for all possible malformed or scientifically wrong responses.

source_unanswerable_accounting: No released task is excluded. A source-unanswerable task stays in denominator142 and is not labeled FN absent a proven equivalent response.
headline_scope: The frozen native-v1 verifier used for the 26/100 primary accuracy headline fails this robustness gate.
repaired_adapter_distinction: Adapter-v2 artificial-parser audit (0/693 invalid artificial cases and 0/15 selected scientifically wrong probes accepted) is a separate repaired endpoint. It neither repairs nor retroactively qualifies the frozen native-v1 headline verifier.
raw_policy: Per-probe model rationales and full rows are not retained in the committed aggregate report; the deterministic protocol and audit script regenerate them locally.
